key_insight: Abstracting QCCD trapped-ion hardware into architectural archetypes enables platform-aware compilation and highlights hardware–compiler co-design as essential.
engineering_relevance: Register layout and connectivity shape routing costs, so compiler requirements should inform trapped-ion hardware design.
method: Abstract QCCD architectures and native operations into generic compilation models.
Apply compilation methods to one- and two-dimensional architectures.
Extend the analysis to compilation with quantum error correction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports routing overhead scaling approximately cubically with qubit count in the studied one-dimensional architecture and quadratically in the two-dimensional architecture.
watch_item: These scaling results concern the studied architectures; the abstract does not specify benchmark sizes or establish universal performance guarantees.
paper_title: From QCCD Trapped-Ion Hardware to Quantum Compilers: Capabilities, Architectures, and Compilation
